name: Yoruba
notes: Standard Yoruba. Seven oral vowels /i e ɛ a ɔ o u/ (⟨i e ẹ a ọ o u⟩) and five nasal vowels /ĩ ɛ̃ ã ɔ̃ ũ/; there are no nasal counterparts of /e/ and /o/, which is why ⟨en⟩ and ⟨on⟩ are NOT nasal-vowel spellings. ⟨p⟩ = the labial-velar stop /k͡p/, ⟨gb⟩ = /ɡ͡b/, ⟨ẹ⟩ = /ɛ/, ⟨ọ⟩ = /ɔ/, ⟨ṣ⟩ = /ʃ/, ⟨j⟩ = /dʒ/ (also analysed as the palatal stop /ɟ/). /r/ is phonetically an alveolar tap [ɾ], not a trill (Akinlabi 2004; also Bamgboṣe, A. (1966) 'A Grammar of Yoruba', p.7). TONE: Yoruba has three level tones — high, mid, low — and the orthography writes them on the vowel with an acute, nothing, and a grave respectively, so tone is recoverable from spelling and the spec emits it. High is ◌́, low is ◌̀, and an orthographically unmarked vowel is MID, emitted with the IPA mid-tone diacritic ◌̄ rather than left bare: mid is a specified tone in Yoruba, not the absence of one (Bamgboṣe 1966; Akinlabi 2004). NASAL VOWELS: ⟨n⟩ that follows one of the five nasalisable vowels and is not itself followed by a vowel spells nasalisation of that vowel and is not a consonant of its own — ⟨un⟩ /ũ/, ⟨in⟩ /ĩ/, ⟨an⟩ /ã/, ⟨ọn⟩ /ɔ̃/, ⟨ẹn⟩ /ɛ̃/. Before a vowel the same ⟨n⟩ is an ordinary onset /n/, which the positional_graphemes before_vowel overrides restore (⟨ana⟩ /ānā/, not */ãā/). The tone diacritic is written AFTER the nasalisation tilde so the result composes to the same NFC string as the standard notation (ũ + ́ = ṹ). KNOWN GAPS, not modelled: (1) the syllabic nasal written ⟨n⟩ before a consonant (⟨nkọ⟩, ⟨njẹ⟩) is left as /n/ — its place assimilation is analysis-dependent and the wikipron gold itself splits between a nasal vowel and a syllabic [ŋ] for medial ⟨Vn⟩+C (367 vs 148 tokens), so the majority reading is kept; (2) nasalisation of a vowel AFTER ⟨m⟩/⟨n⟩ (the [m]~/b/, [n]~/l/ allophony) is not applied, because the gold shows it holding for only about two thirds of such vowels and the loanword exceptions are not modelled. GOLD CONVENTION: the vox_communis 'yo' row is epitran-derived — a machine gold with no tone and inconsistent nasal-vowel handling — so it scores AGREEMENT with epitran, not accuracy, and emitting tone necessarily moves that row a long way. Rank Yoruba on the wikipron row. See docs/languages/yo.md.
